name: Teen Library Leaders, Santa Clara City Library
org: Santa Clara City Library (City of Santa Clara)
what_you_do: Plan and help run library programs for kids and teens, and give the library advice as a teen advisor. Any high school teen can also come to the monthly meetings and share ideas.
who_can_apply: High school students who live in the City of Santa Clara or go to school in the Santa Clara Unified School District. Only 3 to 5 teens are picked as leaders each school year. Monthly meetings are open to any high school teen.
duration: One school year, with monthly meetings.
deadline_text: Leaders are picked at the start of each school year. The application form for the next school year is on the page. No closing date is given.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Library Leader Application form on the page. You must finish the city's onboarding for volunteers. You can also just come to a monthly meeting.
notes: Leaders earn service hours. The page still shows the spring meeting dates (Thursdays at 5 pm on Feb 12, Mar 19, Apr 9 and May 7), which look like 2026 dates. Ask the teen librarian (kguzman@santaclaraca.gov) for this year's dates and when leaders are picked.
